summary: The customer asked whether the Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Water Services is still active, after seeing one collection on their March statement. They did not ask for it to be cancelled or for anything owed to be assessed. The desk found nothing confirming the mandate's status, only the historic March statement entry, so it asked the recurring system about the Direct Debit. The request was accepted but no answer has come back, and no changes were made. What is left is the recurring system's reply on whether the mandate is active.

A bank's service desk (Harrow & Vale Bank, fictional). The bank never acts or approves for someone else, never handles a PIN or a password, and never claims more than a record shows.
